local_review.finding_body:
The replacement calls org.springframework.modulith:spring-modulith-starter-core:2.1.0 a class-bearing dependency, but its Maven Central JAR contains zero `.class` files and `metadata/org.springframework.modulith/spring-modulith-starter-core/index.json` already marks it not-for-native-image. Removing it from this contribution's marker would not complete the repair: `publish_not_for_native_image.py` snapshots `reason` and `replacement` before local review and passes a non-callable descriptor input, which `branch_publication.py` reuses after reviewer edits. The eventual descriptor and PR body would therefore retain the false guidance. The contribution cannot be safely repaired without changing shared publication infrastructure.

Infrastructure issue: https://github.com/oracle/graalvm-reachability-metadata/issues/10775 (#10775)
local_review.finding_title: Not-for-native-image review repairs leave stale descriptor guidance
local_review.review_comment:
I verified that the diff is limited to one artifact index, the target 2.1.0 JAR has no JVM class files, the marker reason is accurate, and index validation passes. The test, native-execution, metadata-entry, and coverage rules are not applicable to this marker-only contribution. The replacement guidance is not final or accurate: it describes spring-modulith-starter-core:2.1.0 as class-bearing even though that JAR also has zero class files and is already marked not-for-native-image. A marker-only repair would leave the immutable descriptor render input stale, so this requires the shared publication path to be corrected before approval.

Infrastructure issue: https://github.com/oracle/graalvm-reachability-metadata/issues/10775 (#10775)

render.reason: The published JAR for org.springframework.modulith:spring-modulith-starter-jpa:2.1.0 contains only META-INF files (MANIFEST.MF, LICENSE, NOTICE, maven pom/properties) and no JVM class files; it is a dependency-aggregating starter POM whose runtime classes are supplied entirely by its dependencies.
render.replacement: Use class-bearing dependencies such as org.springframework.modulith:spring-modulith-events-jpa:2.1.0, org.springframework.modulith:spring-modulith-events-core:2.1.0, org.springframework.modulith:spring-modulith-events-jackson:2.1.0, org.springframework.modulith:spring-modulith-events-api:2.1.0, and org.springframework.modulith:spring-modulith-starter-core:2.1.0.
